response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: Yes! You're a friend of Lady Arlecchino's, and someone my boss respects. So of course I have to pay you the utmost respect too!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why are you here instead of in Fontaine?

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: Oh, it's just some usual shuffling of personnel.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: The Lady Marionette's troops took quite a hit earlier and will need some time to return to their full combat capabilities...

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: Apart from local reinforcements, Lady Arlecchino has also sent several companies here to Nod-Krai to strengthen the defense of the design bureau along with some other areas.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: Now that things have settled down in Nod-Krai, the companies are getting ready to head back to their old posts. That's why I've been given block leave, and the reason I'm lucky enough to take part in this competition.

choices.text: Yeah, why not? If the food's already on the table, might as well dig in.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: Ah... I just realized it's all gone... My apologies.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: I'll make sure to bring more sweets from Fontaine next time, so I'll always have some on hand if I see you again.

choices.text: That's not how the Fatui Operatives behave!

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: Should I say, "I've been waiting for you" and strike right away?

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: If you want, you could have it.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: But if I raise my arms against you in Nasha Town and Lady Arlecchino finds out, I'll certainly be punished.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: Besides, I'm not that arrogant. I wouldn't dream of trading blows with you without some rules to keep things in check.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: And according to my students, you'd beat me in an instant. So I'd best not make a fool of myself.

dialogues.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
dialogues.text: If you become one of us, you'd certainly be an instructor of the instructors at the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
dialogues.text: It's just too bad that given your abilities, there probably isn't any organization in the world that's good enough for you.

dialogues.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
dialogues.text: Ooh, looks like everyone's happy with the results of the competition. Time for me to head back to work.

dialogues.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
dialogues.text: Life is unpredictable, and no one knows what the future holds... Maybe one day, if I get fired from the Fatui and you have your own team... I might just come join you?

dialogues.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
dialogues.text: If that time ever comes, I hope you won't turn me away for being too weak.
